title: Diplomatic Reception Hall
purpose: Foreign-affairs sector card and statecraft surfaces.
story: A diplomatic reception hall before the guests arrive — the stage of nations meeting, gilded and expectant.
environment: A grand reception hall, a parquet floor stretching beneath chandeliers, tall mirrored doors along the walls.
architecture: Palatial state interior — gilt pilasters, a painted ceiling cove, a colonnade of mirrored portals receding into shadow.

people.notes: Two figures near a far doorway, seen from behind in formal dress; no face toward the camera.

composition: The parquet leading down the hall's central axis, one chandelier catching warm light, mirrored doors marching into deep negative space.
negativeExtra: any writing on walls or panels
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette of scene-01; gilt reads as warm brass, never bright.
